capabilities: Capture short notes into a searchable timeline
Filter notes by full text, tag, and date; pin, star, or archive them
Store notes as yearly Canvas files in the vault
Send text, images, or files from a desktop WeChat bot for capture
disambiguation: It does not convert notes to the standalone Memos app; it re-creates that card-feed experience inside the vault using Canvas files.
extras: Distributed under a Source Available License; commercial use requires separate authorization. Bilingual Chinese/English interface. The flomo migration is a guide for AI assistants, not an in-plugin importer.
intentEvidence: UNmemos is a Memos-inspired flash-note plugin for people who want their quick notes to stay in their vault
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fast capture feed for fleeting thoughts that stays searchable and remains ordinary Canvas files in the vault.

relations.evidence: UNmemos is a Memos-inspired flash-note plugin
The optional desktop connection can work alone or route messages with UNagent

summary: Memos-inspired flash-capture plugin that saves quick notes as Canvas files and shows them in a searchable timeline with tags, references, and WeChat capture.
